يتشانأ (form VI)

# يَتَشَانَأَ (yatašānaʔa) /ja.ta.ʃaː.na.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# يَتَشَانَأْ (yatašānaʔ) /ja.ta.ʃaː.naʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
